segments.name: Regulated Electric Utility
segments.description: Generates, purchases, transmits, distributes and sells electricity to retail and wholesale customers in eight states.
segments.evidence: The regulated electric utility segment generates, purchases, transmits, distributes and sells electricity in Colorado, Michigan, Minnesota, New Mexico, North Dakota, South Dakota, Texas and Wisconsin

segments.name: Regulated Natural Gas Utility
segments.description: Purchases, transports, stores, distributes and sells natural gas to customers in portions of five states.
segments.evidence: The regulated natural gas utility segment purchases, transports, stores, distributes and sells natural gas primarily in portions of Colorado, Michigan, Minnesota, North Dakota and Wisconsin

revenueModel.text: Xcel Energy earns regulated revenues from selling electricity and natural gas to retail and wholesale customers, with rates recovered under state-regulated tariffs.
revenueModel.evidence: the revenue streams are dependent upon regulated rate recovery, which is separately determined for each segment
